     6→interface MergeStrategy<T> {
     7→    fun merge(documents: List<ChangedData<T>>): List<ChangedData<T>>
     8→
     9→    fun merge(before: ChangedData<T>?, after: ChangedData<T>): ChangedData<T>? =
    10→        when {
    11→            before == null -> after
    12→
    13→            // c -> c : 중복 이슈, after 1개만 수행
    14→            // u -> c : 비정상, c를 수행하여 최신화
    15→            // d -> c : d 무시, c만 수행 (over-write)
    16→            after.op == Operation.CREATE -> after
    17→
    18→            // c -> u : 최신 데이터인 after를 선택하고 대신 op는 c로 변경
    19→            // u -> u : latest
    20→            // d -> u : 비정상, '미노출 되어야 하는데 노출'되는 것보다 '노출되어야 하는데 미노출'되는 것이 상대적으로 나아 d 수행
    21→            before.op == Operation.CREATE && after.op == Operation.UPDATE -> after.apply { op = Operation.CREATE }
    22→            before.op == Operation.UPDATE && after.op == Operation.UPDATE -> after
    23→            before.op == Operation.DELETE && after.op == Operation.UPDATE -> before
    24→
    25→            // after가 delete면 이전 event는 중요하지 않음 (무조건 delete)
    26→            after.op == Operation.DELETE -> after
    27→
    28→            else -> null
    29→        }
    30→
    31→    fun diffLog(before: ChangedData<*>, after: ChangedData<*>): String =
    32→        "${before.op} -> ${after.op}, " +
    33→                "before=(partition=${before.partition},offset=${before.offset},id=${before.id}), " +
    34→                "after=(partition=${after.partition},offset=${after.offset},id=${after.id})"
    35→}

    32→                }

    36→                category = dependency.categories[it.afterData?.categoryId],
    37→                brand = dependency.brands[it.afterData?.brandId],

    11→    BulkRequest
    12→        .Builder()
    13→        .apply {

    15→                when (document.op) {
    16→                    Operation.CREATE -> {
    17→                        operations { op ->
    18→                            op.index { idx ->
    19→                                idx
    20→                                    .index(indexName)
    21→                                    .id(document.id)
    22→                                    .document(document.createDocument)
    23→                            }
    24→                        }
    25→                    }
    26→
    27→                    Operation.UPDATE -> {
    28→                        operations { op ->
    29→                            op.update<T, Map<String, Any?>> { upd ->
    30→                                upd
    31→                                    .index(indexName)
    32→                                    .id(document.id)
    33→                                    .action { action ->
    34→                                        action
    35→                                            .doc(document.updateData) // 전체 overwrite or partial
    36→                                            .docAsUpsert(false) // 문서 없으면 생성할지 여부
    37→                                    }
    38→                            }
    39→                        }
    40→                    }
    41→

### 3. KAFKA CDC PIPELINE: END-TO-END FLOW

**Topics Consumed:**
- `cmn-search-team.search.catalog.refine.v2` (Avro CDC for Catalogs)
- `cmn-search-team.search.product.refine.v2` (Avro CDC for Products)
- `cmn-search-team.search.index.admin.v1` (JSON admin commands)

**Pipeline Stages:**

```
Kafka Message (Avro CatalogCdcEnvelope/ProductCdcEnvelope)
    ↓ (1) Listener receives batch
CatalogDynamicIndexListener.onMessage() / ProductDynamicIndexListener.onMessage()
    ↓ (2) Map Avro to domain
ChangeDataMapper.toChangedCatalogData() / toChangedProductData()
    → ConsumerRecord<SpecificRecord, SpecificRecord> → ChangedData<Catalog/Product>
    ↓ (3) Merge duplicate events for same ID
MergeStrategy.merge() (CatalogMergeStrategy / ProductMergeStrategy)
    → Groups by ID, applies C/U/D priorities
    → Tracks shouldFetchCategory/Brand/Manufacturer/Mall flags
    ↓ (4) Assemble with external dependencies
AssembleService.assemble(documents)
    → ProxyApplicationService.fetchDependencies() (concurrent GraphQL calls)
    → Fetches Category, Brand, Manufacturer, Mall data
    → Maps to CatalogDocument / ProductDocument
    ↓ (5) Evaluate indexing eligibility
Evaluator.evaluate(document: IndexDocument<T>)
    → Currently: true by default (no special rules yet)
    ↓ (6) Build ES bulk request
EsRequestBuilder.buildBulkRequest(indexName, documents)
    → For CREATE: index operation
    → For UPDATE: update operation with doc field
    → For DELETE: delete operation
    ↓ (7) Execute bulk to Elasticsearch
ElasticsearchTemplate.bulk<T>(bulkRequest)
    ↓ (8) Commit Kafka offset
acknowledgment.acknowledge() → Commit to broker
```

### 4. MERGE STRATEGY LOGIC (DETAILED)

**MergeStrategy Base** (`domain/index/policy/MergeStrategy.kt`):

Priority matrix for merging events with same ID:
```
Operation Precedence (applied left-to-right, latest offset wins):
  CREATE → CREATE   = CREATE (duplicate, use latest)
  UPDATE → CREATE   = CREATE (data refresh)
  DELETE → CREATE   = CREATE (overwrite delete)
  
  CREATE → UPDATE   = UPDATE (but op becomes CREATE for fresh insert)
  UPDATE → UPDATE   = UPDATE (latest data)
  DELETE → UPDATE   = DELETE (preserve delete to avoid incomplete data)
  
  Any → DELETE      = DELETE (final state always honored)
```

**EsRequestBuilder** (`outbound-adapter/index/helper/EsRequestBuilder.kt`):
```kotlin
fun <T> buildBulkRequest(indexName: String, documents: List<IndexDocument<T>>): BulkRequest =
    BulkRequest.Builder().apply {
        documents.forEach { document ->
            when (document.op) {
                Operation.CREATE -> {
                    operations { op ->
                        op.index { idx ->
                            idx.index(indexName)
                               .id(document.id)
                               .document(document.createDocument)
                        }
                    }
                }
                Operation.UPDATE -> {
                    operations { op ->
                        op.update<T, Map<String, Any?>> { upd ->
                            upd.index(indexName)
                               .id(document.id)
                               .action { action ->
                                   action.doc(document.updateData)
                                         .docAsUpsert(false)  // No insert if missing
                               }
                        }
                    }
                }
                Operation.DELETE -> {
                    operations { op ->
                        op.delete { del ->
                            del.index(indexName).id(document.id)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }.build()
```
